annotations.title: Change what data a Napkin interface can use

description: Set the sheet tables, Ledger metrics and Workbench Tasks an interface may use (ADR 0085, 0086), replacing the whole list. Tables: access read, add (read and add records) or edit (also change and delete); optionally limit to some columns by name. Metrics: read or record. Tasks: the page may start them. The page then calls zw.tables.query / add / update / remove, zw.metrics.read / record and zw.tasks.start / get. Anyone who can open the interface, including people it's shared with, gets this access (a shared link can only read and add), so ask the user before widening it.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

columns.description: Column names to allow; omit for all.

table.description: The table tab's name or id.

tasks.description: Workbench Tasks the page may start with zw.tasks.start, and check with zw.tasks.get.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
